papers.title: Quantum Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning via Variational Quantum Circuits
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning is one of the most challenging learning paradigms where efficacy and efficiency gains are extremely valuable. Hierarchical reinforcement learning is a variant that leverages temporal abstraction to structure decision-making. While parametrized quantum computations have shown success in non-hierarchical reinforcement learning, whether these advantages adapt to hierarchical decision-making remains a critical open question. In this work, we develop a hybrid hierarchical agent based on the option-critic architecture. This hybrid agent substitutes classical components with variational quantum circuits for feature extractors, option-value functions, termination functions, and intra-option policies. Evaluated on standard benchmarking environments, results show that a hybrid agent utilizing a quantum feature extractor can outperform classical baselines while saving up to 66\% trainable parameters. We also identify an architectural bottleneck that quantum option-value estimation severely degrades performance. Further ablation studies reveal how architectural choices of the quantum circuits affect performance. Our work establishes design principles for parameter-efficient hybrid hierarchical agents.

analysis.summary: 提出基于option-critic架构的量子分层强化学习智能体，用变分量子电路替代关键组件，实现超越经典基线性能并节省66%可训练参数。
analysis.research思路: 探索参数化量子计算在分层强化学习中的适用性，将量子优势从非分层RL扩展到利用时间抽象的分层决策范式。
analysis.experiment: 在标准基准环境评估混合智能体，对比量子特征提取器与经典基线的性能、参数量和训练效率。
analysis.innovation: 首次将变分量子电路应用于分层RL的全部核心组件（特征提取、选项值、终止函数、策略），实现参数效率显著提升。
analysis.related_work: 参数化量子RL、option-critic架构、分层强化学习中的时间抽象、量子机器学习中的变分电路。
analysis.impact: 验证了量子计算对分层决策问题的潜力，为量子增强的分层RL开辟新方向，同时识别出量子选项值估计的架构瓶颈。
analysis.reviewer_note: 原文摘要存在截断，末尾'that quantum option-value est'显示关键结论未完整呈现，建议核实完整论文以确认具体发现。

domain_trend.trend: 该论文实际属于量子机器学习领域，与近场光学领域不符，无法提供近场光学领域的有效分析。
domain_trend.development_direction: 该研究属于量子计算与强化学习的交叉领域，验证了变分量子电路在分层决策问题中的潜力，开辟了量子增强分层RL的新方向，但与近场光学领域无直接关联。建议提供符合近场光学领域的论文以进行准确分析。

papers.title: Microscopic theory of a radiation-balanced solar laser
papers.abstract: We develop a microscopic open-quantum-system theory for a radiation-balanced solar laser (RBSL) based on ytterbium-doped yttrium aluminum garnet (Yb:YAG), in which optical gain, thermal redistribution among sublevels of the electronic ground and excited manifolds, and lattice-temperature dynamics are treated within a unified framework. Starting from a Lindblad master equation for a multilevel gain medium coupled to a cavity mode, we include incoherent solar pumping, spontaneous emission, cavity loss, and phonon-assisted intra-manifold relaxation obeying detailed balance. In the regime of fast thermalization within each electronic manifold, a compact temperature-dependent two-level model is derived, in which the gain, inversion, and lasing threshold are controlled by Boltzmann occupation factors and partition functions of the electronic sublevels. This microscopic reduction is then coupled self-consistently to a thermal balance equation accounting for anti-Stokes fluorescence cooling, quantum-defect heating, parasitic absorption, and heat exchange with the environment. The theory predicts several operating regimes, including pure cooling, lasing with net cooling, and lasing with net heating, as well as dynamical effects such as delayed lasing onset induced by self-cooling into threshold. In contrast to earlier radiation-balanced laser (RBL) models based mainly on macroscopic rate equations and thermodynamic balance arguments, the present approach provides a microscopic description of the feedback between quantum optical dynamics and temperature redistribution. It therefore offers a physically transparent framework for analyzing RBSLs and for identifying design strategies that exploit level structure, thermalization, and photonic-environment engineering to stabilize laser operation while minimizing internal heat load.

analysis.summary: 开发了Yb:YAG辐射平衡太阳能激光器的微观开放量子系统理论，将光学增益、热弛豫与晶格温度动力学在统一Lindblad框架下处理，推导出温度依赖的两能级模型并自洽耦合热平衡方程。
analysis.research思路: 解决太阳能激光器中光-物质相互作用与热管理耦合的核心问题，将传统激光物理中分离处理的增益介质能级结构、声子弛豫和晶格加热在量子统计框架下统一描述，实现无热负荷激光运转的理论预测。
analysis.experiment: 基于Lindblad主方程建立多能级增益介质耦合腔模的理论模型；引入非相干太阳泵浦、自发辐射、腔损耗和满足详细平衡的声子辅助流形内弛豫；在快速热化极限下约化为温度依赖的两能级模型并耦合热平衡方程。
analysis.innovation: 首次将微观量子理论应用于辐射平衡激光器，建立增益/反转/阈值与电子子能级玻尔兹曼占据因子和配分函数的显式关系；实现增益动力学与反斯托克斯荧光冷却的自洽耦合；为辐射平衡激光器提供了普适的理论预测工具。
analysis.related_work: 辐射平衡激光概念（Bog模等）、Yb:YAG太阳能泵浦激光（枋口组等）、激光热效应理论、荧光冷却理论（Epstein组）、固体激光器速率方程模型。
analysis.impact: 为辐射平衡太阳能激光器的设计和优化提供了严谨的微观理论基础，架起了宏观激光工程与量子统计力学的桥梁，对高功率太阳泵浦激光、太空中激光应用等领域具有重要指导意义。

papers.title: OptiLookUp: An Optical ROM-Based Loop up Table Engine for Photonic Accelerators
papers.abstract: Read-only memory (ROM) provides deterministic access to predefined data mappings. Extending ROM concepts to the optical domain enables high-bandwidth, low-latency, and parallel memory access, but realizing compact and reconfigurable optical ROM remains challenging due to loss, wavelength control, and integration constraints. This work presents a high-speed, reconfigurable photonic ROM architecture implemented using integrated microring resonators (MRRs). The ROM encodes predefined input-output mappings directly in the spectral response of the photonic devices, enabling deterministic lookup-based operation without dynamic computation during readout. To improve scalability and reduce cumulative insertion loss, the architecture employs compact banked sub-arrays that are selectively addressed through an optical decoding mechanism. Reconfigurability is achieved using transistor-based optical selectors, allowing different ROM banks to be activated without physical light rerouting or interferometric structures. The proposed photonic ROM is designed and evaluated using device-level simulations based on the GlobalFoundries 45SPCLO silicon photonics platform. Simulation results demonstrate reliable operation at data rates up to 12.5 GHz, with stable light-to-current transfer characteristics obtained through integrated photodiode readout. The optical ROM can be used to implement nonlinear activation functions utilised in photonic accelerator architectures, including sigmoid, tanh, ReLU, and exponential mappings.

analysis.summary: 提出基于微环谐振器的光学ROM架构，通过光谱编码实现高速确定性查找，利用banked子阵列和晶体管选择器突破光学存储的紧凑性与可重构性瓶颈。
analysis.research思路: 解决光学域ROM面临的高损耗、波长控制复杂、集成困难等问题，探索在光子芯片上实现紧凑、可重构且低插入损耗的只读存储器。
analysis.experiment: 采用集成微环谐振器(MRRs)阵列构建ROM核心，通过光学解码实现banked子阵列选择性寻址，使用晶体管基光学选择器控制 bank's激活。
analysis.innovation: 首次将ROM查找表概念完整迁移至光子域；实现读取时无需动态计算的确定性操作；兼顾可重构性与低损耗的可扩展架构设计。
analysis.related_work: 光子矩阵计算、光学神经网络、片上光互连、微波光子存储、集成光子器件的波长多路复用技术。
analysis.impact: 为光子加速器提供高效的查找表引擎支撑，推动光子计算从矩阵运算向更复杂的数据映射扩展，对AI推理和高性能计算具有重要应用价值。
